purpose: SendGru — LinkedIn connection invitation with personalized note
prerequisites: LinkedIn logged in (Premium recommended for unlimited notes)
Column H note length 1-300 characters before send (Premium)

steps.notes: First profile after lock: no pre-navigate sleep. Every later profile: sleep 60-90s BEFORE this navigate.
Confirm profile loaded; check stop_phrases in page text via CDP if needed
If already 1st-degree (Message only) or Pending, skip person — do not mark row Sent

steps.skip_if_missing: Send without a note — skip person, report no note option

steps.notes: Paste exact column H text. Re-check length <= 300 (Premium). Do not edit sheet in browser.
Dialog should close; profile may show Pending. On failure do not write Sent add note.

after_row_success.condition: At least one person on row sent successfully; mark row only after finishing all sendable people for that row (up to 2)

rules: Never type into Google Sheet in browser
Never run in Jobgru pipeline — user must name rows explicitly
Max 2 /in/ URLs per row from column G
Skip rows where H is already Sent add note
Stop entire session on stop_phrases — no retries
Do not send InMail — connection invite + note only
